## Agent / capability

Name and one-sentence purpose.

## User value

What real user problem does this solve?

## Required capabilities

- [ ] Microphone
- [ ] Speaker
- [ ] Display
- [ ] Camera
- [ ] BLE
- [ ] Lua
- [ ] Memory
- [ ] Network
- [ ] External tools/APIs

## Permission model

Explain the minimum permissions required and why.

## Processing boundary

Describe what can run locally and what requires a remote provider.

## Security & privacy impact

Threats, sensitive data, retention, consent and failure modes.

## Acceptance evidence

Define how this could progress from `PREPARED` to `MEASURED` without confusing simulation with physical validation.
